faqs.question: I see horizontal or vertical lines in my printout. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Perform a nozzle check from the printer's control panel or the Epson printer driver, then do one of the following:
If there are gaps in the nozzle check pattern, clean the print head nozzles.
If there are no gaps in the nozzle check pattern, try the solutions below.
Horizontal Banding
Increase the print resolution.
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Select an alternate paper profile for ink coverage.
Select the correct paper type in the printer driver.
Adjust the paper feed
Vertical Banding
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Align the print head.

faqs.question: The colors on my printouts do not match the colors on my computer monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following recommended color correction methods:
Use ICC profiles during the color management process.
Ensure that you are using the correct output profile for your loaded media.
Note:
You may need to create a custom ICC profile for the best results.
Ensure that your monitor is calibrated and is displaying accurate color.
Compare the print result with the image on your computer screen in a well-lit environment. Since monitors and printers produce colors differently, printed colors and screen colors do not always look the same.
If the recommendations above do not help, contact Epson support.
The color management process is complex. We can assist you with the proper assignment of settings; however, we cannot assist you with creating a custom color profile.

faqs.question: I see the message Communication Error when I use a USB connection. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Delete all print jobs in the print queue.
Turn the printer off.
Note:
Make sure the USB cable is connected correctly.
Restart your computer. When the desktop appears, turn your printer on and follow the on-screen instructions.
Note:
If the problem continues, turn the printer off again and delete the printer in the list of printers. Then disconnect the USB cable from the printer and connect it again.

faqs.question: What is the capacity of the ink tanks on my product?
faqs.answer: The refillable high capacity ink tanks hold up to 1.5 liters per color.

faqs.question: Can I reuse the ink chips that come with the ink packs?
faqs.answer: The ink chips are not reusable.  An ink chip is provided with each ink pack. The chip unit helps to alert you to when you may be low on ink.

faqs.question: Can I use my product's ink packs and ink tanks with other Epson products?
faqs.answer: The ink packs and tanks are designed specifically for the F-Series line of printers and will not work with other Epson products. The SureColor F6070 and F7070 use the same ink packs and tanks.

faqs.question: How do I refill the ink tanks?
faqs.answer:
See
Replacing the Ink and Chip Unit
for instructions.

faqs.question: What size ink pack does my product use?
faqs.answer: The printer uses 1 liter packs for each ink color.

faqs.question: How many ink tanks are installed in my product?
faqs.answer:
The printer uses four ink tanks, cyan, magenta, yellow, and black. See
Options and Consumable Products
for more information.

faqs.question: Do I need to install a new chip unit each time I refill the ink tank with a new ink pack?
faqs.answer: Yes, a new ink chip needs to be installed with every new pack of ink.

faqs.question: What is the smallest drop size that is produced by my product?
faqs.answer: The smallest droplet size is 5.3 picoliters.

faqs.question: What is the media width that is supported with my product?
faqs.answer:
The printer supports a media width of 11.8 inches to 64 inches wide. See
Supported Media
for more information.

faqs.question: Does Epson sell media for the SureColor F7070?
faqs.answer:
Epson does have some media available, however, most media is available through third party vendors. See
Supported Media
for more information.

faqs.question: Is there an Epson driver supplied with my product?
faqs.answer: There is no standard Epson driver supplied with the printer.  A communication driver is supplied with the printer but can only be used for updating the firmware.  The RIP software is used to print.

faqs.question: What RIP is provided with my product?
faqs.answer: The printer is bundled with the Wasatch SoftRip.

faqs.question: What is on the CD that came with my product?
faqs.answer:
The CD contains the following items:
Epson Professional Communication Driver for Windows
Epson LFP Remote Panel 2
EpsonNet Setup
EpsonNet Config
Wasatch SoftRip ® TX Epson F7070 Edition

faqs.question: Can I setup and install my product on my own?
faqs.answer: No, the printer cannot be installed by the end user.  The dealer will perform the installation of the printer.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for support?
faqs.answer: Epson supports all service issues with the printer and RIP software.  Should the product require service, contact support to schedule a service call.

faqs.question: Where can I find drivers, utilities, and firmware for my product?
faqs.answer: You can check the Downloads tab for your product.

faqs.question: Does Epson provide training on how to use my product?
faqs.answer: Epson does not provide training on product use.  Training is provided by the dealer.

faqs.question: Who can I contact for support on the heat press?
faqs.answer: You will need to contact the manufacturer of the heat press.  Epson does not offer support or warranty on the heat press.

faqs.question: What are the user replaceable parts for my product?
faqs.answer:
See
Options and Consumable Products
.

faqs.question: Will my product print on fabric?
faqs.answer:
No, the printer does not print directly onto fabric. It is designed to print on media, which can then be transferred to fabric.  See
Supported Media
for more information.

faqs.question: Does my product include a heat press?
faqs.answer: No, the heat press is not manufactured by Epson and can be purchased separately from a dealer.

faqs.question: What interface connections are available?
faqs.answer:
The printer supports hi-speed USB-compatible with the USB 2.0 specification and 100BASE-TX/1000Base-T* connections.
* Use a shielded twisted pair cable (category 5 or better).

faqs.answer:
See our
